title: Enumeration to account takeover
summary: Connect a reliable account oracle, weak online-attack controls, MFA weakness, and session persistence into an account-takeover hypothesis.
safety: Use only designated disposable identities and synthetic credentials. Never spray, stuff breached credentials, trigger real-user MFA prompts, or retain tokens.

nodes.label: Confirm a reliable login account oracle
Verify MFA completion cannot be bypassed
Verify other sessions can be terminated after factor changes

edges.condition: A repeatable account-existence signal is confirmed.
The bounded attack model shows practical credential-guessing exposure.
A designated account can reach authenticated state without required MFA.
